UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user profile in the AnonConnect application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

interests.description: A list of user interests, represented as tags.

lastActive.description: The date and time the user was last active.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Represents a single chat message exchanged between users.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ChatMessage entity.

senderId.description: Reference to UserProfile. The ID of the user who sent the message. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ChatMessage)

recipientId.description: Reference to UserProfile. The ID of the user who received the message. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ChatMessage)

content.description: The text content of the message.

timestamp.description: The date and time the message was sent.

ChatSession.title: ChatSession
ChatSession.description: Represents a single chat session between two users.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ChatSession entity.

user1Id.description: Reference to UserProfile. The ID of the first user in the chat session. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ChatSession)

user2Id.description: Reference to UserProfile. The ID of the second user in the chat session. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ChatSession)

startTime.description: The date and time the chat session started.

endTime.description: The date and time the chat session ended.

Report.title: Report
Report.description: Represents a report filed against a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Report entity.

reporterId.description: Reference to UserProfile. The ID of the user who filed the report. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Report)

reportedUserId.description: Reference to UserProfile. The ID of the user who was reported. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Report)

timestamp.description: The date and time the report was filed.

BannedUser.title: BannedUser
BannedUser.description: Represents a user who has been banned from the platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the BannedUser entity.

userId.description: Reference to UserProfile. The ID of the banned user. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:1 BannedUser)

banDate.description: The date the user was banned.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to support the core features of AnonConnect, including anonymous video chat, text chat, interest-based matching, reporting, and banning. The structure prioritizes authorization independence by denormalizing relevant data, ensuring security rules can be applied efficiently without relying on hierarchical `get()` calls.

1.  **User Profiles:** Stored in `/user_profiles/{userId}`. This collection holds user profile data.  There are no subcollections.  User profiles are critical for identity and interest-based matching.

2.  **Chat Sessions:** Stored in `/chat_sessions/{chatSessionId}`.  A `ChatSession` document holds the metadata for a given session.  This collection supports listing active sessions and querying sessions by user IDs.

3.  **Chat Messages:** Stored in `/chat_sessions/{chatSessionId}/messages/{messageId}`. This subcollection of `chat_sessions` contains individual chat messages.  Authorization is based on membership in the parent `chat_session` document, ensuring that only participants can read/write messages. The `chatSessionId` parameter enables efficient querying of messages within a specific session. The `senderId` and `recipientId` properties are indexed to facilitate message retrieval for a user.

4. **Reports:** Stored in `/reports/{reportId}`. This collection stores reports filed against users.  Authorization rules can ensure that only authenticated users can create reports and that moderators can read them. 

5.  **Banned Users:** Stored in `/banned_users/{userId}`. This collection stores a list of banned users. Existence of a document in this collection is sufficient to indicate a banned user, making the security rules simple and efficient. Existence over content is used here.

**Authorization Independence:**

*   **Chat Messages:** The `ChatSession` includes the `user1Id` and `user2Id` this information is automatically inherited by subcollection `messages` providing the information to allow/deny read/write operations. This denormalization prevents security rules from having to traverse the database.

**QAPs Support:**

*   **List Operations:** The segregation of data into dedicated collections (e.g., `/user_profiles`, `/chat_sessions`) ensures that list operations can be performed securely, with rules tailored to each collection's specific access requirements.  The use of path-based ownership (`/user_profiles/{userId}`) allows for efficient retrieval of user-specific data.

This structure promotes security, scalability, and debuggability by adhering to the core design principles of Authorization Independence, Clarity of Intent, DBAC, and QAPs.
